name: Warlord's Command
label: Quest
description: Warlord's Command: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: By order of Warlord Goretooth, the following inhabitants of Blackrock Spire must be destroyed:
The cruel and ruthless troll, War Master Voone.
Overlord Wyrmthalak, taskmaster of the lesser city.
You will also be required to return any important documents that you may find.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Warlord Goretooth's dull green skin turns a pasty white for a brief moment.
